description: A small open cardboard box sits on the desk near a closed laptop, with a few pieces of clothing, a snack packet, and a paper cup nearby. The left hand holds the box steady and shifts it slightly, while the right hand picks up a green garment and drops it into the box, then adds an orange garment, places a small packet on top, sets a boxed item into the box, and finally lifts a paper cup and lays it on its side inside the box.
